description: This file is a script for running and managing a regression testing process for gateway watches in a Node.js environment. It handles argument parsing, directory snapshotting, executing timed processes, and producing reports on build artifacts and performance metrics.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to override default options.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths by replacing backslashes with forward slashes.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists all entries in the directory tree starting from a given root.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the directory tree including file and directory counts and sizes.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Writes directory tree info to a snapshot directory.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously and throws if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Builds the command and environment to run the timed watch process.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses timing information from a file generated by /usr/bin/time.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs the watch process with timing and manages its termination, collecting logs and timing info.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads and parses path list files.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Creates diff reports of directory entries between pre- and post-build snapshots.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout and stderr logs to determine why a build was triggered.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Builds environment, configuration, and paths needed for running the node-based build.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main orchestrator function executing the sequence of steps for the regression test.
